comingLast.roast: on 11 - the escape committee (his foursome) has convened
2 points of daylight - barely enough to read by
the cushion is 4 - more of a coaster really
a 5-point cushion over Elsley - thin ice, heavy walker
hovering 6 above the double blue - altitude: uncomfortable
7 clear with holes in hand - the maths likes him, the course may not
one quiet stretch from joining Elsley in the conversation nobody wants
above the blue balls by 8 - margin thinner than the clubhouse gravy
his buffer is 9 - his group has stopped mentioning it, loudly
10 points from infamy - every 1-pointer counts double now
